How much time does it take to mod a system sub?

It depends on the sub, how active the community is, how active your mod team is, and how much time you're willing to put in. /v/gaming has an active community and a steady stream of posts, but our modteam is pretty active and spread out across a few good time zones. It also depends on how strict your community's rules are, since firmer rules require more moderator activity. In this regard moderating for a system sub is actually less demanding because they tend to have clear and relaxed rules. Specialty subs might have additional rules about what format posts need to be in.

I usually keep /v/gaming/new open in a tab on my browser all day so I can apply link flair to posts as they come in, and correct the occasional post that might break one of the community's rules. Usually it's a simple title correction or something else that's easy to fix and redo, so catching those posts early (within twenty minutes on a good day) means less inconvenience for the person posting, and no loss of ongoing discussion since none has started yet.
